# Template — Post-PR/MR workflow (`.maestra/workflow.md`)

> Source: round R15 (issue #49) + ADR-004 · Module version: 1 — 2026-08-18
> Anti-drift: separate from `config.md` by design — the config parser (ADR-014) accepts only 4 keys and silently ignores the rest (ADR-002); this file carries the post-acceptance workflow convention. Platform-neutral (ADR-012): values are repo-specific names; columns are resolved against the real board via the cookbook.

```markdown
# Post-PR/MR workflow

<!-- ADR-004: generated by the setup journey (J12 STAGE 1); edit by hand to remap. -->

- post-pr-acceptance: close | qa
- qa-approval-column: {board column for QA-approved work — default: the delivered mapping in labels.md}
```

**Rules:**
- `close` is the default when the file or the key is absent — teams without formal QA change nothing (zero migration: current behavior preserved).
- **Convention, not cache:** column names are always revalidated against the REAL board when operating (P6); this file records the human-confirmed convention, and on divergence the board wins and the file is corrected in the act.
- Born in the setup journey (J12 STAGE 1): the facilitator proposes the default `close`; if the team runs post-merge QA, `qa` is set with the QA Specialty reference (`team.md`) and the approval column confirmed from the real board.
- Remap = partial J12 invocation ("reconfigura o workflow pós-PR/MR") or manual edit — one file, one place.
- Versioned in the repository ("no state outside the repository").
